title: Chain Spark Runner
heading: Chain Spark
help: Pick a step and click Green flag. Drag fireworks into the sky (click one to turn it), drag the match next to one, press Space.

1.name: Place
1.note: Clones in the tray; set drag mode draggable; a click turns 45 degrees.

2.name: Light
2.note: Space: the match flares; a shell touching it bursts into a ring of 20 sparks.

3.name: Chain reaction
3.note: Touching the sparks' yellow sets a firework off.

4.name: Rockets and fountains
4.note: A rocket flies its way with a trail of sparks; a fountain sprays.

5.name: Score
5.note: Points per firework (rockets few) and show-time points while they burn.

6.name: The finale
6.note: The end of the show, and a bonus when all eight went off. The whole game.
